Data Analyst (Ads & Sponsorships)

General Information

Locations: Springfield. Role ID 1001. Worker Type Regular Employee. Work Model Hybrid.

Description & Requirements

The Ads and Sponsorships analytics team measures how paid campaigns and partner sponsorships perform across the studio's games. You will build the reports the sales and marketing teams use to decide where the next budget goes.

You will write SQL against the warehouse every day, turn campaign logs into dashboards, and explain what moved a number in plain words to people who do not read code. You will work with two engineers and one scientist on the team, and you will own the weekly sponsorship review.

  • 3 or more years of analytics work, ideally in advertising or live-service games
  • Strong SQL and one scripting language for analysis
  • A habit of checking a result before it is shared

Acme Games is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes people of every background.
